name: Mantis Blades Mk-IV
description: Retractable mono-molecular edged blades integrated into the forearm cybernetics. Capable of slicing through most materials with surgical precision.

gm_notes.special_notes: AP rounds don't affect, counts as edged weapon

name: Optical Camouflage Suit
description: Military-grade adaptive camouflage system that adjusts to environmental conditions. Provides near-perfect invisibility in most lighting conditions.

gm_notes.notable_suppliers: Military black market, Corporate espionage gear

name: Neuralware Deck v3.7
description: Advanced neural interface allowing direct connection to the Net. Features enhanced ICE protection and quantum encryption protocols.

gm_notes.special_notes: Requires Interface skill 6+ to use effectively

name: Thermal Katana
description: Traditional katana enhanced with thermal edge technology. The blade heats to 2000°C on activation, cauterizing wounds instantly.

gm_notes.special_notes: Ignores 2 points of armor, cauterizes wounds (+2 to stabilization)

name: Breach Protocol Toolkit
description: Comprehensive hacking suite containing quantum processors, signal amplifiers, and custom malware. Essential for any serious netrunner.

name: Subdermal Armor Plating
description: Titanium-alloy plates surgically implanted beneath the skin. Provides protection without compromising mobility or appearance.

gm_notes.notable_suppliers: Body modification clinics, Corporate med centers
gm_notes.special_notes: Not obvious, +4 difficulty to detect

name: EMP Grenade Mk-II
description: Electromagnetic pulse grenade designed to disable electronic systems. Effective against drones, vehicles, and cybernetic implants.

name: Biomonitor Implant
description: Real-time health monitoring system that tracks vitals, toxin levels, and neurological activity. Includes automatic emergency response protocols.

gm_notes.special_notes: Automatic poison/drug detection, alerts medic

name: Smart Pistol X-45
description: AI-assisted sidearm with smart targeting system. Features biometric lock, wireless ammo counter, and predictive trajectory calculation.

gm_notes.special_notes: Requires smartgun link, +1 WA with smart ammo

name: Memory Chip Encoder
description: Specialized device for encoding, decoding, and manipulating memory chips. Can extract data from damaged or encrypted storage devices.

gm_notes.notable_suppliers: Data recovery services, Tech black market

name: Cybereye Mk-III
description: Advanced optical implant with multiple vision modes, telescopic zoom, and recording capabilities. Replaces natural eye completely.

gm_notes.special_notes: Obvious chrome, +2 to spot hidden objects

name: Assault Rifle AR-70
description: Military-grade assault rifle with selective fire modes. Features smart targeting system and modular attachment points.

gm_notes.special_notes: Can mount accessories, armor piercing ammo available

name: Nomad Leathers
description: Heavy leather armor reinforced with kevlar weave and ceramic plates. Traditional protective gear of the nomad clans.

gm_notes.special_notes: Popular with nomads and bikers, intimidating appearance
gm_notes.durability: Reduces by 1 SP per 10 points of damage taken

name: Scrambler Unit
description: Electronic warfare device that jams communications and disrupts targeting systems within its operational range.

gm_notes.affects: Radio, cellphones, smart weapons, vehicle electronics
gm_notes.detection: Electronics skill 15+ to detect active jamming
gm_notes.special_notes: Illegal to use in most corporate zones

name: Smartgun Link
description: Neural interface that connects directly to compatible smart weapons, providing enhanced targeting and ammunition tracking.

gm_notes.special_notes: Only works with smart weapons, shows ammo count

name: Trauma Team Beacon
description: Emergency medical transponder that automatically summons Trauma Team when life signs become critical.

gm_notes.activation: Automatic at 2 health levels or manual
gm_notes.special_notes: Requires active subscription, GPS trackable

name: Monofilament Whip
description: Flexible molecular wire weapon that can cut through almost any material. Extremely dangerous to both target and wielder.

gm_notes.special_notes: Cuts through any armor, 1 in 6 chance to break per use
gm_notes.notable_suppliers: Assassin gear dealers, High-tech black market

name: Corporate Body Armor
description: High-end executive protection suit disguised as business attire. Provides excellent protection while maintaining professional appearance.

gm_notes.detection: Very Difficult (25+) to spot as armor
gm_notes.special_notes: Hardened against armor piercing, climate controlled

description: Portable netrunning terminal with advanced ICE-breaking capabilities and stealth protocols for deep Net infiltration.

gm_notes.special_notes: Portable, harder to trace than fixed systems

description: Lightweight handgun made from ceramic composites. Designed to avoid metal detectors while maintaining stopping power.

gm_notes.special_notes: Undetectable by metal scanners, ceramic ammo available

description: Neural enhancement that accelerates reaction time and motor responses. Provides significant advantage in combat situations.

gm_notes.special_notes: Requires weekly maintenance, power hungry

description: Advanced medical diagnostic device capable of detailed biological analysis and trauma assessment in field conditions.

gm_notes.special_notes: Detects poisons, diseases, implants, drug traces

description: Form-fitting bodysuit with sound dampening and thermal masking properties. Favored by infiltrators and corporate spies.

gm_notes.special_notes: Muffles sound, masks heat signature

description: Full arm replacement with enhanced strength and integrated tool systems. Popular among construction workers and soldiers.

gm_notes.special_notes: Can mount weapons or tools, obvious chrome

description: Motion-activated explosive device with adjustable trigger sensitivity. Used for area denial and perimeter security.

gm_notes.special_notes: Motion sensor, can be remote detonated

description: Portable secure storage device with military-grade encryption and anti-tamper mechanisms. Essential for data runners.

gm_notes.special_notes: Unbreakable encryption, requires owner's biometrics
